channel.title: Via Fidelitatis — Faithful FI for Catholic Families
channel.description: Practical financial independence tools and faith-filled stewardship insights for Catholic families. FI calculator, college planning, and generational wealth rooted in fidelity.

item.title: Build on Trust, Not Anxiety: Lessons from Our Lady of the Snows
item.description: On the Dedication of the Basilica of Saint Mary Major, Catholic families learn that trusting Providence — the same trust that marked the snow in summer — creates the practical margin that turns financial independence into everyday freedom from anxiety.

item.title: Simplicity Creates Real Margin: Lessons from St. John Vianney
item.description: On the Memorial of St. John Vianney, Catholic families learn that deliberate simplicity creates the practical margin that turns financial independence from a distant goal into everyday freedom.

item.title: Build Margin for True Hospitality: Lessons from St. Lydia
item.description: On the Memorial of St. Lydia, Catholic families learn that financial independence creates the practical margin to open their homes and tables without anxiety — turning everyday hospitality into a living act of faith.

item.title: When Little Is Enough: Lessons from the Loaves and Fishes
item.description: On the Eighteenth Sunday in Ordinary Time, Catholic families learn from the multiplication of the loaves that trust and margin turn scarcity into generosity — and that financial independence is one practical way to live that Gospel freedom.

item.title: Detachment Creates Real Freedom: Lessons from St. Alphonsus Liguori
item.description: On the Memorial of St. Alphonsus Liguori, Catholic families learn that true financial freedom begins with detachment from status and anxiety — and that FI is one practical way to create the margin that makes that freedom possible.

item.title: Serve Without the Anxiety: Lessons from Martha, Mary, and Lazarus
item.description: On the Memorial of Saints Martha, Mary, and Lazarus, Catholic families learn how financial independence creates the margin to serve like Martha without the anxiety Jesus corrected — and to be present like Mary.

item.title: Build a Money Sabbath into Your Week
item.description: A simple weekly habit that quiets money anxiety, protects family time, and helps Catholic households practice the detachment St. Augustine described — so financial independence can actually feel free.

item.title: Build Margin to Give Freely: Lessons from St. Pantaleon
item.description: On the feast of St. Pantaleon, the unmercenary physician, Catholic families learn that financial independence creates the practical freedom to serve and give without calculating the return.

item.title: Lessons from Joachim and Anne for Building a Lasting Family Legacy
item.description: On the Feast of Saints Joachim and Anne, Catholic families can rediscover that the greatest inheritance is a child formed in faith and freedom — and that financial independence is one of the practical tools that makes this formation possible.

item.title: Treat Your FI Journey Like a Pilgrimage: Lessons from St. James for Catholic Families
item.description: On the Feast of St. James, Catholic families can see the path to financial independence as a pilgrimage — one step, one prayer, one faithful decision at a time that builds lasting freedom and legacy.

item.title: AI Meal Planning for Catholic Families: Stretch the Budget and Accelerate FI
item.description: Busy Catholic parents can use simple AI prompts to cut grocery waste, plan realistic family meals, and free up real cash that accelerates the path to financial independence.

item.title: Protect Your Family’s Digital Privacy: Stewardship Tools That Belong on the Path to FI
item.description: Identity theft and data brokers drain time, money, and peace. How Incogni and Surfshark help Catholic families protect their household as part of faithful financial independence.

item.title: Catholic Families: AI for Back-to-School Savings and Faith-Filled Financial Freedom
item.description: As back-to-school season hits, Catholic families can use AI to save on supplies, plan wisely, and stay on the fast track to FI while teaching kids stewardship and generosity.

item.title: Praying Your Way to Financial Freedom
item.description: A faith-first approach to FI: how prayer, generosity, and smart planning help Christian families build wealth and peace.

item.title: How Christian Couples Unlock Financial Freedom Together
item.description: Christian couples sharing practical steps to build FI as a team, rooted in faith, communication, and shared vision for their family's future.

item.title: Faithful Parenting on the Path to FI
item.description: How faithful parenting and FI work together to create margin for faith, family time, and raising kids with strong values.

item.title: Catholic Parents Building FI Legacy with AI and Prayer
item.description: A practical guide for Catholic parents to integrate AI tools and daily prayer into their journey toward financial independence and family legacy.

item.title: Catholic Moms & Dads Use AI to Build Debt-Free, Faith-Filled Family Legacy
item.description: Real strategies for Catholic parents to use AI for budgeting, debt payoff, and raising kids with faith and financial wisdom.

item.title: Catholic Families Harness AI for Prayerful FI and Generational Legacy
item.description: Learn how Catholic families are using AI alongside prayer to build lasting financial freedom and a legacy of faith for generations.

item.title: AI-Assisted Stewardship: How Catholic Families Leverage Smart Tools for FI and Faithful Living
item.description: Discover practical AI prompts and tools Catholic families are using to budget, plan, and live out faithful stewardship on the path to FI.

item.title: Raising Faith-Filled Kids While Building Financial Freedom
item.description: How to teach your children about money, faith, and stewardship for a strong generational legacy and debt-free future.

item.title: Catholic Dads Leading Family FI with AI and Faith
item.description: Practical ways Catholic dads are using AI tools to steward family finances while leading in faith and presence for their kids.

item.title: Catholic Families: Leverage AI for Prayerful Financial Freedom and Lasting Legacy
item.description: With the Pope’s new encyclical on AI, Catholic families can use smart tools alongside prayer to accelerate their path to financial independence and build a faith-filled legacy for their kids.

item.title: Raising Generous, Grounded Kids: Faith, Family Budgeting & Shared Financial Freedom
item.description: Teach kids generosity early, model contentment, and build a household culture where money serves the mission instead of the other way around.

item.title: Stewarding Your Family’s Future: Building Generational Wealth Through Faith and FI
item.description: Financial independence isn’t just about early retirement — it’s about creating a lasting legacy of faith, generosity, and wise stewardship for the next generation.

item.title: Why Financial Independence Is for Everyone
item.description: Financial independence isn’t just for tech bros or high earners — it’s for regular families ready to build margin, faith, and freedom.
